label: +0.5 cm Soft (Both Sides)
description: A 5mm soft pad is the classical bespoke standard — substantial enough to project a definite, authoritative shoulder line while remaining visibly rounded and human rather than squared off. The soft construction means the pad compresses naturally under pressure and presents a gently curved profile that echoes the natural deltoid rather than fighting it, giving the jacket both presence and ease. This is the padding weight favoured by the great London houses for day suits: purposeful enough to command attention, comfortable enough to wear for twelve hours without fatigue.
